# Stock keyed-serializer Wide `Array(Bool)` fixture

Generated by `scripts/generate_public_bool_array_fixture.sh` with
`BOOL_ARRAY_SERIALIZATION_VARIANT=keyed` using the pinned ClickHouse
26.7.1.1315 official build in a disposable local store. It contains the same
synthetic sorted-key paired schema and values as `wide_array_bool`; stock
`CHECK TABLE` returned success before capture.

The keyed fixture omits the sparse-serialization setting and records the
primary-key `Default` serializer entry for `pk` in `serialization.json`. Its
13 rows use six two-row marks and a one-row final mark. The exact data
substreams are `plain.size0`, `plain`, `maybe.size0`, `maybe.null`, and
`maybe`; each Bool payload and nullable map has one byte per flattened leaf.
LZ4 data, plain `.mrk2` marks, and a sentinel record are retained. `SHA256SUMS`
pins every captured part file.

The generator checks the stock version, schema, substream inventory, row
count, exact keyed serializer metadata, and `CHECK TABLE` before copying. Scope
is this pinned build and schema; this is not evidence for other nested-type
layouts.
